contract_grounding.expected_behavior: API should reject string-encoded vectors and require actual array type

source_grounding.call_chain_traced: handleInsert → WrappedInsertRequest.AsInsertRequest → convertFieldDataArray → FieldData.AsSchemapb → json.Unmarshal with automatic type coercion
source_grounding.note: 源码接地发现:FloatVector case使用json.Unmarshal直接解析raw JSON,无类型检查。Go的json.Unmarshal内置类型强制转换,接受字符串"[0.1,0.2,0.3,0.4]"并自动转为[][]float32。无显式type guard或schema validation。

falsification.observed: Insert succeeds (HTTP 200, insertCount=1) - BUG CONFIRMED. Type coercion silently accepts string instead of rejecting with type error.

verdicts.rationale: REST v2 entities+insert端点接受vector字段为字符串而非数组。源码显示FloatVector case (wrap_request.go:232-237) 使用json.Unmarshal直接解析,无type guard。Go的json.Unmarshal自动将字符串"[0.1,0.2,0.3,0.4]"转为[][]float32,绕过schema类型检查。此行为违反contract明文要求(FLOAT_VECTOR应为float32数组)且命中已知blindspot pattern(REST_v2_data_type_handling, 26 historical cases)。干净复现成功(HTTP 200, insertCount=1),证伪通过(无平凡解释),源码接地确认validation_absent。
